description: Source file for Vite utility functions and configuration related to Playwright component testing, including directory resolution, endpoint setup, config creation, component population, and index file transformation.

methods.name: resolveDirs
methods.description: Resolves component directories based on configuration and project settings.

methods.name: resolveEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs server endpoint configuration from full project config.

methods.name: createConfig
methods.description: Creates a Vite configuration object based on directories, project config, and framework plugin.

methods.name: populateComponentsFromTests
methods.description: Populates component registry from test data.

methods.name: hasJSComponents
methods.description: Checks if any components are JavaScript-based.

methods.name: transformIndexFile
methods.description: Transforms index files to include React import or component registration code.

methods.name: frameworkConfig
methods.description: Retrieves framework-specific configuration from the full project config.
